## Dataset

Dataset: Comparative Birth, Death, Marriage data, Ontario Data Catalogue.

This R Markdown file downloads the official Ontario CSV and uses `ggplot2` to create the visualization. The plotting table is derived in code; no manually prepared summary table is used.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

data_url <- "https://data.ontario.ca/dataset/7d6d02f8-140f-467d-a7c1-861480cadb6d/resource/8f40d667-b379-41c6-b929-cdcce6e0ada7/download/comparative_birth_death_marriage_data_1925-2025.csv"
local_csv <- "data/comparative_birth_death_marriage_data_1925-2025.csv"

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

download.file(data_url, local_csv, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
raw <- read.csv(local_csv, check.names = FALSE)

find_col <- function(keyword) {
  matches <- names(raw)[grepl(keyword, names(raw), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(matches) == 0) stop(paste("No column contains", keyword))
  matches[1]
}

year_col <- find_col("Year")
birth_col <- find_col("Live Births")
death_col <- find_col("Deaths")
marriage_col <- find_col("Marriages")

first_year <- 1994

# 2024 and 2025 are deliberately excluded because the Ontario catalogue labels
# them preliminary. The catalogue says 2023 is the most current published annual
# report year, so 2023 is the latest complete/final year used in the charts.
last_year <- 2023

row_first <- raw[raw[[year_col]] == first_year, c(birth_col, death_col, marriage_col)]
row_last <- raw[raw[[year_col]] == last_year, c(birth_col, death_col, marriage_col)]

plot_data <- data.frame(
  event = c("Live births", "Deaths", "Marriages"),
  value_1994 = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", c(row_first[[birth_col]], row_first[[death_col]], row_first[[marriage_col]]))),
  value_2023 = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", c(row_last[[birth_col]], row_last[[death_col]], row_last[[marriage_col]])))
)
plot_data$change_pct <- (plot_data$value_2023 - plot_data$value_1994) / plot_data$value_1994 * 100
plot_data$change_label <- paste0(ifelse(plot_data$change_pct >= 0, "+", ""), round(plot_data$change_pct), "%")
plot_data$event <- factor(plot_data$event, levels = c("Live births", "Deaths", "Marriages"))
plot_data
```

```{r}
r_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = event)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = value_1994, xend = value_2023, yend = event), colour = "#b9c0b3", linewidth = 2.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = value_1994, colour = "1994"), size = 4.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = value_2023, colour = "2023"), size = 4.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = pmax(value_1994, value_2023) + 6500, label = change_label),
    colour = "#202124",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4.3,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("1994" = "#666666", "2023" = "#2b7bba"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x / 1000), "K"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.17))) +
  labs(
    title = "How Ontario Vital Event Registrations Changed",
    subtitle = "1994 vs 2023, with percent change labelled for each event type.",
    x = "Registered events",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfbf8", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfbf8", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#5f6368"),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#5f6368", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#202124"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#202124")
  )

r_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/visualization_2_r_1994_2023_change.png",
  plot = r_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 150,
  bg = "#fbfbf8"
)
```
